Altered Space - A 3-D Alien Adventure.name: Altered Space
Altered Space - A 3-D Alien Adventure.summary: The player is an astronaut trapped on an alien spaceship who has to try to find his way out while avoiding aliens and continually replenishing his oxygen supply. This was the first isometric view game on the Game Boy
